title: drain.json — drain plan and receipt
description: The plan a drain run writes before drafting and the receipt it updates after posting. The plan pins one canonical pending list with a digest, typed skips for threads verdict authored but did not draft, and a count of other people's threads. The agent writes drain.replies.json against that digest; no host write happens in this build.

schema_version.description: Plan format version; only "1" is published.

provider.description: The host whose thread feed was read.

pr.description: Pull-request number the plan belongs to.

head_sha.description: The bundle head the feed was read at.

planned_at.description: UTC time the plan was written, RFC 3339.

self.description: The authenticated login the feed's verdict-authored roots must match.

plan_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical pending list; drafts name it to prove they answer this plan.

pending.description: Threads waiting on a verdict reply, oldest waiting comment first, capped by --max-threads.

skipped.description: Verdict-authored threads the plan did not draft, each with a machine-readable reason.

other_threads.description: Threads verdict did not author; counted but never listed as skips.

drafts.description: The validated draft summary, or null before an agent drafts.

posted_at.description: UTC time posting finished, or null before post mode.

pending.description: One waiting thread joined to its finding anchor and the comment that needs an answer.

skip.description: One thread left open and why: resolved, answered, bot-reply, already-replied, not-review-comment, or deferred.

drafts.description: What the agent wrote: the file name, entry count, and disposition tally.

dispositions.description: Counts of answer, withdraw, and defer drafts.

posted.description: One reply the host accepted and whether its thread was resolved.

failed.description: One thread whose write failed and why.
